title: Sculk Corruption
description: Adds sculk pretty nice if i say so myself
body: SkulkCorruption is a Minecraft server plugin that spreads sculk blocks throughout the Overworld and Nether dimensions, creating an apocalyptic corruption event. Players must survive the expanding sculk corruption and find refuge in the End dimension. The plugin features configurable spread speed, optional damage effects, and darkness effects for corrupted areas. Server admins can control the corruption using the /skulk command to start, stop, monitor status, and adjust spread speed.
